Exact weight updates give log z/log t→-1; the bounded martingale strong law gives good-edge frequencies. Endpoint cases and the three-node independent-geometric clock follow directly. value.rationale: The motivating paper documents the counterintuitive phenomenon that suppressed edges are still sampled infinitely often. This theorem answers the directly motivated quantitative question of how many costly incompatible contacts persist, with a topology-independent leading constant, an exact finite-time threshold clock in the smallest realizable opinion network, and sharp zero/logarithmic/linear endpoint regimes. The result informs simulation and communication-cost interpretation, independent of any unproved global convergence-rate improvement.
